title: Notice Promptness on Delivered Not Received and Lost in Transit Claims
content:
Under Delivery Claims, the delivery-charge refund for a parcel that never reached the customer reflects how promptly the claim was opened after the carrier's delivered date.

**Term.** The report share depends on how many counted days after the carrier's delivered date the claim was opened: 8 or more counted days pay 80% of the basis, 5 to 7 counted days pay 90%, and 4 or fewer pay the whole basis.

The report days run from the order's recorded delivered date to the date the claim was opened.

| Report days | Share of the basis paid |
|---|---|
| 4 or fewer | 100% — the whole basis |
| 5 to 7 | 90% |
| 8 or more | 80% |

## Band edges

| Report days | Share |
|---|---|
| 4 | 100% |
| 5 | 90% |
| 7 | 90% |
| 8 | 80% |

*Hypothetical:* on a basis of 10.00 USD, a claim opened 6 report days after the delivered date is paid 90%, 9.00 USD, on this term; opened 9 report days after, 80%, 8.00 USD.
